label: Post a notice
description: A step of an events automation: posts `text` as a notice — written to the log, and pushed to the window — naming `event` when it is given. It asks nothing of anyone. `event` is handed on unchanged so the next step can read it (`.children.<this step>.output.event`). Every input is optional so a mount can be wired by its line's own `inputs` alone; a notice with no `text` fails at run time.

event.description: The event the automation fired on — `.event` — which the notice names. Unconstrained: `.event` is typed by nothing a checker can see.
The event this step was handed, for the next step.
